Issue / finding: Japanese page initially contains English body text
Evidence: html lang=ja; H1: Engineering partners built for lasting results; Japanese is applied by JavaScript
Impact: Initial language mismatch for readers and non-JavaScript crawlers
Recommended fix: Serve Japanese HTML initially and use separate crawlable English output

Issue / finding: Header and footer require JavaScript
Evidence: Empty rx-header / rx-footer containers are populated by site.js
Impact: Navigation and company contact details depend on script execution
Recommended fix: Render shared navigation and footer in HTML at build time

Issue / finding: Quote and application forms have no native delivery fallback
Evidence: qf and apf have no action or method; submit handlers call sendMail
Impact: Without working scripts a form cannot deliver a request correctly
Recommended fix: Add a server endpoint with POST and progressive enhancement

Issue / finding: Live form delivery has not been verified
Evidence: Active endpoint: formsubmit.co/ajax/info@rynextech.com; W3F_KEY is empty
Impact: Lead or application loss if delivery service is inactive or blocked
Recommended fix: Submit a controlled test and verify actual inbox receipt and error handling

Issue / finding: CAPTCHA explicitly disabled
Evidence: sendMail appends _captcha=false; hidden _honey field is present
Impact: Spam resistance relies on limited client-side measures and provider controls
Recommended fix: Verify provider rate limits and add appropriate bot protection

Issue / finding: Email-app fallback cannot attach the CV
Evidence: mailtoLink keeps string fields only and excludes File objects
Impact: Applicant may assume CV is included when it is omitted
Recommended fix: Show an explicit instruction to attach the CV manually

Issue / finding: Optional Web3Forms path drops the CV
Evidence: When W3F_KEY is configured the code calls fd.delete(cv)
Impact: Enabling this alternate provider would silently omit uploaded resumes
Recommended fix: Use a provider that supports attachments or clearly disable the upload field

Issue / finding: Language change can replace newsletter error text with success text
Evidence: setLang: if nlmsg.textContent then nlmsg.textContent = UI[l].sub
Impact: A prior failed subscription can appear successful after changing language
Recommended fix: Store success/error state and translate the matching message

Issue / finding: Homepage URL conventions differ
Evidence: Canonical and og:url use /index.html while Japanese hreflang uses /
Impact: Duplicate URL signals are less consistent
Recommended fix: Choose one canonical URL and align redirects, hreflang, OG and internal links

Issue / finding: Public numerical claims need supporting records
Evidence: 50+ completed projects; 98% positive reviews; over 70% of enterprise clients start with a pilot
Impact: Unsubstantiated figures can weaken client confidence
Recommended fix: Document calculation period, sample and supporting records; revise if unsupported

Issue / finding: IP ownership wording has different timing
Evidence: FAQ says 100% IP belongs entirely to client; later says rights assigned upon milestone payment
Impact: Clients may misunderstand when ownership transfers
Recommended fix: Use one precise ownership and payment trigger consistent with signed contracts

Issue / finding: Strong support commitments need verified capacity
Evidence: FAQ advertises 24/7/365 enterprise coverage and Critical P1 response under 15 minutes
Impact: Sales promises may exceed available coverage
Recommended fix: Validate staffing and escalation capacity; define response vs resolution and SLA exclusions

Issue / finding: Quote budget is offered only in US dollars
Impact: Japanese prospects must convert their budget
Recommended fix: Offer JPY ranges or a currency selector

Issue / finding: Shared CSS is approximately 258 KB before compression
Evidence: Downloaded style.css: 257758 bytes; transfer compression and browser timings not measured
Impact: Potential stylesheet overhead; actual user impact is unmeasured
Recommended fix: Measure compressed transfer and unused CSS before optimizing

Issue / finding: Responsive layout and keyboard/screen-reader behavior require browser tests
Evidence: This audit inspected HTTP responses and source only
Impact: Visual overlap, focus traps and contrast issues are not ruled out
Recommended fix: Test phone and desktop widths, keyboard navigation, dialogs and screen readers

Issue / finding: No form submissions or authenticated checks performed
Evidence: No emails, applications or newsletter requests sent; no admin or repository access
Impact: Delivery, backend security and private deployment state remain unverified
Recommended fix: Complete controlled functional tests and an authorized backend review
